title: RoleDefinition
description: SAIA-Class S role definition describing a governance or operational role within Beast System 3.0.

description.description: Optional description of the role's purpose and scope.

authorityLevel.description: Authority code associated with this role (e.g., SOVEREIGN, DELEGATE, OBSERVER).

permissions.description: List of permissions granted by this role.

tags.description: Optional classification tags for grouping or filtering roles.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the role definition was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the role definition was last updated.
